description: REQ-006 ('WHEN run.sh observes outcome=="unverified" ... move the clip file to $CLIP_PENDING_VERIFY') never specifies whether the paired caption sidecar file ($CAP, the .txt originally selected alongside the .mp4) also moves. This matters because: (1) the CURRENT, unchanged code (run.sh:94-95) always moves the .mp4 AND its .txt together on success ('mv "$CLIP" "$POSTED/"' followed by 'mv "$CAP" "$POSTED/"'), establishing an existing pair-move convention this new requirement silently breaks or must explicitly continue; (2) run.sh's own clip-selection loop (run.sh:34-38) requires a .mp4 with a matching same-basename .txt to even be selected as a candidate -- if $CAP is left behind in queue/ while the .mp4 moves to pending-verify, that .txt becomes a permanently orphaned file with no matching .mp4, silently accumulating in queue/ forever (violates HARD RULE 0.26 disk hygiene) with zero cleanup path specified anywhere in this spec or its proof obligations (PROP-005/006 do not assert on the caption file's location in the unverified case).

evidence.snippet:
for f in "$QUEUE"/*.mp4; do ... c="${f%.mp4}.txt"; if [ -f "$c" ]; then CLIP="$f"; CAP="$c"; break; fi; done  # selection requires paired .txt
mv "$CLIP" "$POSTED/" ...; mv "$CAP" "$POSTED/" ...  # existing code always moves BOTH together
